Due to hygiene reasons this product is excluded from our 30 Day Money Back Guarantee (your statutory rights are not affected).

Lightweight reusable and disposable P3 rated mask for multi-shift use 8+ hours a day. 99%+ filtration efficiency and APF20. Hepac-Lite filter technology for highest particulate protection and ultra-low breathing resistance captures dust as fine as 0.3 microns at 50Ltr/min. Suitable for all woodworking tasks, masonry and demolition work, fibreglass, mixing concrete, mortar and plaster, welding, hand and power sanding. Full elastomer moulded facepiece structure for ultimate face seal. Downward-facing exhalation valve for no misting or steaming of goggles.
